title: Operator Acceptance Store
description: Contract for the operator-acceptance ledger (default `_state/acceptances.json`) — owner-gated entries recording that operator-owned checks were explicitly accepted without execution. Structural validation is hand-rolled at runtime (zero dependencies); this schema documents the shape. The `prd` pattern shows the DEFAULT id pattern; runtime validation derives it from workflow.config idPattern.

owner.description: Must be one of workflow.config owners (role identities, never person names; the allowlist is config, not schema).

method.description: How the acceptance was recorded, e.g. "interactive" or "--yes".

authorship.description: Who TYPED the entry, beside `owner`, which names who DECIDED. `owner-written` — an owner wrote it directly. `agent-transcribed` — an agent wrote it on explicit in-session owner direction; the decision is still the owner's, and `owner` still names them. This is a record, not an enforcement: nothing prevents a false value, and nothing can. It exists so authorship is queryable rather than buried in four phrasings of `method`, and so a concealed authorship is an affirmative false statement instead of an unreadable ambiguity.
